source.text:
Hey Everyone, Andrej here, I wanted to showcase a small service that I built for automatically transferring invoices from Cliniko to QuickBooks. I don't believe that such a service yet exists so if you or somebody you know uses both Cliniko and QuickBooks to manage their small medical practice, there's a high chance there could be some benefit from this service.

It has a free tier as well as a sandbox which can be tested and played around with at sandbox.invoice-funnel.com. You would need to have both a Cliniko account to create invoices and a QuickBooks account to see them land in case you want to try it out.

Even if you don't use Cliniko or have never heard of it, any general comments/questions or accounting-specific tips would be greatly appreciated!

P.S. Currently this service supports only Cliniko, but if you know of any other app that generates invoices, has a public API and currently no or limited integration with QuickBooks, please do let me know and I can consider on-boarding it.

Thanks for your attention!
source.title: Show HN: Small service for moving invoices from Cliniko to QuickBooks
